name: Kurashina Bambi
source:
The face of the Cyber Force Dolls, established in the Office of Cyber Security Control under the TMPD Cyber Security Control Division; 19 years old.

Bambi joined the force as a police officer in April; she only started to be dispatched a few months prior to the game’s events. She’s a bit of a klutz, but she takes her work very seriously, and is always giving it her all.

As a police officer and an idol, she has her work cut out for her: she needs to attend officer training and idol practice every day.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
